claims.claim_text: SES has entered into joint development agreements (JDAs) with General Motors, Hyundai Motor Company, and Honda Motor Company to jointly develop and produce Li-Metal battery cells and technology.
claims.source_quote: we have partnered with leading global original equipment manufacturers ( OEMs ), General Motors ( GM ), Hyundai Motor Company ( Hyundai ), and Honda Motor Company, Ltd. ( Honda ), among other strategic partners, under joint development agreements ( JDAs ) to jointly develop and produce our Li-Metal battery cells and technology.
claims.subject: General Motors
claims.extraction_notes: Layer 3 Rule 7 (counterparty disclosure threshold): GM is a US filer (CIK 0001467858). A material JDA + equity investment + board seat in SES should show up in GM filings (10-K/10-Q/DEF 14A). Search for 'SES AI' in GM's SEC filings. Note: filing also discloses GM is a related party via 5%+ equity + board seat. If GM filings do not mention SES AI at all, that's a hard contradiction; if they mention SES only as a small JDA, that's calibrated against the JDA framing.

claims.claim_text: SES has a joint development agreement with Honda Motor Company (HMC) to develop Li-Metal batteries; Honda is a foreign filer with SEC 20-F.
claims.source_quote: we have partnered with leading global original equipment manufacturers ( OEMs ), General Motors ( GM ), Hyundai Motor Company ( Hyundai ), and Honda Motor Company, Ltd. ( Honda ), among other strategic partners, under joint development agreements ( JDAs ) to jointly develop and produce our Li-Metal battery cells and technology.
claims.subject: Honda Motor Company
claims.extraction_notes: Honda (HMC) files 20-F as a foreign private issuer. Counterparty-corroboration query restricted to Honda's CIK + 20-F/6-K forms. Acknowledge UNVERIFIABLE rather than false-clean if Honda's 20-F MD&A doesn't disclose individual battery JDAs (foreign filers often omit single-partnership-level detail).

claims.claim_text: SES has a joint development agreement with Hyundai Motor Company; Hyundai is a foreign filer not registered with the SEC.
claims.source_quote: we have partnered with leading global original equipment manufacturers ( OEMs ), General Motors ( GM ), Hyundai Motor Company ( Hyundai ), and Honda Motor Company, Ltd. ( Honda ), among other strategic partners, under joint development agreements ( JDAs ) to jointly develop and produce our Li-Metal battery cells and technology.
claims.subject: Hyundai Motor Company
claims.extraction_notes: Hyundai is a Korean issuer with limited SEC presence (no 20-F filer in the counterparty CIK table). Run an unrestricted EDGAR fulltext for 'SES AI' to catch any cross-filer corroboration (e.g. Hyundai-affiliated US filings, GM/Honda mentioning Hyundai-SES context). Acknowledge UNVERIFIABLE for direct Hyundai corroboration via SEC; absence is not a contradiction.

claims.claim_text: SES plans to achieve development and initial production of B-Sample batteries in 2024, C-Sample batteries in 2026, and commence commercial production of its Li-Metal technology in 2027.
claims.source_quote: Our plan is to achieve the development and initial production of B-Sample batteries in 2024 and C-Sample batteries in 2026, which we expect to enable us to commence commercial production of our technology in 2027.
claims.subject: SES AI Corp.
claims.extraction_notes: Pure forward projection of internal sample/SOP timeline. No external registry exists for in-development battery sample stages. Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) applies with extra weight: this is an aspirational milestone, not an operational claim. Scorer should treat as unadjudicatable directly; cross-check indirectly via SES-1/2/3 (whether OEM partners disclose SES on their published SOP/series-production roadmaps in pre-cutoff filings).

claims.claim_text: SES operates a battery cell development and production facility in Shanghai, China and a battery cell product development facility in Chungju, South Korea, in addition to its US headquarters in Woburn, Massachusetts (plus an electrolyte foundry near Woburn started in January 2024).
claims.source_quote: We currently have an operating facility in Shanghai, China, focused on supply chain development, manufacturing process development, battery cell development and production, AI software, BMS and module development, and an operating facility in Chungju, South Korea, focused on manufacturing process development and battery cell product development. ... at our facilities in Woburn, Massachusetts in the United States, Shanghai, China, and Chungju, South Korea.
claims.subject: SES AI Corp.
claims.extraction_notes: Only the US (Woburn, MA) site is adjudicable via EPA FRS; the Shanghai and Chungju sites are outside EPA jurisdiction and require foreign-registry equivalents. A US battery R&D + electrolyte foundry would plausibly appear in EPA FRS if it handles hazardous chemicals at scale; absence is suggestive but not dispositive for a research-scale facility. Note: SES AI's full registrant name may be 'SES AI Corp.' or 'SES Holdings' — substring 'SES' is broad.

claims.claim_text: SES entered into a JDA with an agreed-upon value of up to $50 million, of which the Company had spent $5.9 million as of December 31, 2023.
claims.source_quote: The JDA has an agreed-upon value of up to $ 50 million, of which the Company has spent $ 5.9 million as of December 31, 2023.
claims.subject: SES AI Corp.
claims.extraction_notes: Bilateral private JDA contract value is internal to the contract; no public registry adjudicates the dollar size of a JDA between two private counterparties. Could only be cross-checked if the counterparty (likely GM, per the related-party disclosure) discloses an offsetting commitment in its own SEC filings. Mark NONE for direct adjudication; indirect cross-check is already captured by SES-1's edgar_fts.query_fulltext on GM CIK.

claims.claim_text: SES is the assignee of granted patents for its Li-Metal battery technology (intellectual-property portfolio).
claims.source_quote: We rely heavily on our intellectual property portfolio, including unpatented proprietary technology. ... We rely upon a combination of the intellectual property protections afforded by patent, trademark and trade secret laws in the United States and other jurisdictions
claims.subject: SES AI Corp.
claims.extraction_notes: USPTO ODP is the preferred patent source. 'SES' alone is too broad (many SES-named entities in unrelated fields); scorer should be prepared to filter for battery-domain titles via the categorize buckets. May need to retry with 'SES AI' or 'SolidEnergy' (legacy name from MIT spinout pre-2022 de-SPAC) as alternative tokens. Acknowledge that registrant-name ambiguity caps confidence; battery-domain category counts are the discriminative signal.

claims.claim_text: SES received financial support (grant/subsidy incentives) from the Government of South Korea to partially offset facility construction costs at its Chungju facility.
claims.source_quote: We have received financial support from the Government of South Korea to partially offset the expense of facility construction and plan to seek additional government financial support to the extent possible. ... In 2022, we also received an incentive award from certain South Korean government agencies.
claims.subject: Government of South Korea

proposed_connector.name: korea_kistep.query_government_subsidy
proposed_connector.description: Korean government R&D and industrial-policy subsidy disclosure registry (KISTEP / NTIS / MOTIE incentive awards by recipient).
proposed_connector.endpoint: https://www.ntis.go.kr/en/ (Korea National Science & Technology Information Service) and https://www.motie.go.kr (Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy press releases)
proposed_connector.rationale: Battery-cell investment in Korea is heavily subsidized via MOTIE / Chungbuk provincial incentives. A claimed Korean government incentive award should appear in NTIS project records or MOTIE press disclosures with recipient and amount. No US registry adjudicates Korean government subsidy claims; this structurally requires a Korean-government source.
proposed_connector.completeness: Public Korean R&D and industrial-incentive awards via NTIS / MOTIE; private bilateral incentives may be partial.

claims.extraction_notes: US connectors (USAspending, EPA FRS) do not cover Korean government incentives. Filing also references a small Shanghai/Jiading district incentive (RMB10,000 in 2020, plus ~RMB11.4M facility-rent/renovation in 2019) — would need a parallel China MIIT/Jiading-district registry connector for full coverage, but the Korean award is the more material claim and is the one proposed here.
